statements.text: Under G.O.Ms.No.31, clearance of the Vigilance section is mandatory for transfer requests.
statements.quote: Clearance of the Vigilance section is mandatory, as per the reference 3rd read above.

statements.text: G.O.Ms.No.31 mandates that no relaxation of the transfer ceiling shall be made without the prior concurrence of the Finance Department.
statements.quote: No relaxation of this ceiling shall be made without the prior concurrence of the Finance Department.

statements.text: Under G.O.Ms.No.31, the ban on transfers was relaxed only for the period from 15-05-2025 to 31-05-2025.
statements.quote: The ban on transfers is relaxed for the period from 15-05-2025 to 31-05-2025.

statements.text: According to Standing Order No.2/2020 of the department, transfer requests received outside the period of relaxation shall be kept pending for consideration during the next general transfers.
statements.quote: As per para (e) of Standing Order No.2/2020 of this Department (Flag B), requests received outside the period of relaxation shall be kept pending for consideration during the next general transfers.

statements.text: Under G.O.Ms.No.19, transfers and postings of staff within a Secretariat Department shall be ordered by the Secretary to Government of that Department.
statements.quote: Transfers and postings of Section Officers, Assistant Section Officers and other staff within a Secretariat Department shall be ordered by the Secretary to Government of that Department.
